input: Buy and learn to use a Dutch oven for camping

gold.taskTitle: Buy and Learn a Dutch Oven for Camping
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to purchase a Dutch oven suitable for camping and develop the skills to use it effectively outdoors.

questions.title: What is your budget for the Dutch oven?
questions.description: Understanding the price range helps narrow down cast iron brands and sizes that fit the user's spending comfort.

questions.title: What size group are you typically cooking for?
questions.description: Group size determines the ideal Dutch oven capacity, measured in quarts, to recommend the right vessel.

questions.title: Do you camp with a fire, charcoal, or camp stove?
questions.description: The heat source directly affects which Dutch oven style — legged vs. flat-bottomed — is most appropriate.

questions.title: How do you plan to transport it to campsites?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user car-camps or backpacks affects weight and portability requirements for the purchase.

questions.title: What kinds of meals do you want to cook?
questions.description: Meal goals — stews, bread, cobblers, etc. — shape which recipes and techniques the user should prioritize learning.

questions.title: How soon is your first camping trip using it?
questions.description: A timeline helps sequence the buying, seasoning, and practice steps so skills are ready in time.

questions.title: Have you used cast iron cookware before at all?
questions.description: Prior cast iron experience determines how much foundational knowledge — seasoning, heat control, cleaning — needs to be covered.
